Name: Miku HD Portraits (HDPortraits)
Author: tikamin557
Description:
[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5672]Miku portraiture HD[/url] (Created byReoneru . Uploaded by[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/48992653]REbonbon[/url])
[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/13216]Miku NPC High-res Portrait[/url] (Created by LiuMu . Uploaded by[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/122749553]Puffeeydii[/url])

﻿This is the "[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/10971]HD Portraits[/url]" version of the above two mods.

The original ”[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/999]Portraiture[/url]” required the use of ”[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1726]PyTK - Platonymous Toolkit[/url]”, which could cause a glitch that significantly increased game load times and save times.
That is why we created this mod.

There are separate files, so please install whichever one you want to use.



Please keep in mind that the original rights to the illustration remain with the creator of the original mod.
